pipelines.name: qcam1
pipelines.pipeline: rtspsrc location=rtsp://mediaserver:8554/queuing-cam1 latency=200 ! rtph264depay ! h264parse ! avdec_h264 ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=BGR ! sscape_timestamp_capture name=timesync ntp-server=ntpserv ! gvadetect model=/home/pipeline-server/models/omz/person-detection-retail-0013/FP32/person-detection-retail-0013.xml model-proc=/home/pipeline-server/models/object_detection/person/person-detection-retail-0013.json inference-region=0 ! queue ! gvaclassify scheduling-policy=latency batch-size=1 inference-interval=1 model=/home/pipeline-server/models/omz/age-gender-recognition-retail-0013/FP32/age-gender-recognition-retail-0013.xml model_proc=/home/pipeline-server/models/omz/age-gender-recognition-retail-0013/age-gender-recognition-retail-0013.json device=CPU inference-region=1 ! queue ! gvainference scheduling-policy=latency batch-size=1 inference-interval=1 model=/home/pipeline-server/models/omz/person-reidentification-retail-0277/FP32/person-reidentification-retail-0277.xml device=CPU inference-region=1 ! queue ! gvametaconvert add-tensor-data=true name=metaconvert ! sscape_post_inference_data_publish name=datapublisher ! gvametapublish name=destination method=file file-path=/dev/null ! appsink sync=true

metadatagenpolicy.description: One of detectionPolicy (default), detection3DPolicy, reidPolicy, classificationPolicy, ocrPolicy

publish_image.description: Publish annotated JPEG to scenescape/image/camera/<cameraid> each frame
